QuestInfo.name: A Member of The Maple Alliance
QuestInfo.0: After establishing friendly relations between the Nova and Cygnus Knights, Neinheart contacts you.
QuestInfo.1: Cygnus is inviting everyone to Ereve to solidify the new alliance.
QuestInfo.2: Cygnus has granted you a special power as a gift. Hopefully the new alliance will bring peace between the two worlds.

0.0: Hello. I am Neinheart, the tactician for the Cygnus Knights.
0.1: Empress Cygnus has invited you to Ereve to offer a gift to solidify the alliance between the Maple Alliance and Nova people. Will you come here, to Ereve?\r\n

yes.0: Superb. I will be waiting for you.

no.0: That is too bad. It would be a great opportunity to meet face-to-face.

1.0: It's a pleasure to meet you. I am Cygnus. Thank you very much for coming on such short notice.
1.1: I've heard of your accomplishments in Maple World. Your help will mean a great deal for us. And our alliance will lend you a hand when you need it.
1.2: I've prepared a small gift to solidify our new alliance.

yes.0: This will prove that you are a member of the Maple Alliance. I hope you will find it useful. May the alliance serve the needs of all.\r\n
